proposed.explanation: To fulfill the investor's goal of long-term growth, we compare the four companies. For Telecom Egypt (ETEL), net profit for 2024 was 10,111,328,000 EGP and for 2025 was 22,578,063,000 EGP, with earnings per share of 11.93 EGP and a price of 141.95 EGP, giving a P/E of 11.90. For CIB (COMI), net profit for 2024 was 55,256,732,000 EGP and for 2025 was 82,258,815,000 EGP, with basic earnings per share of 18.25 EGP and a price of 128.00 EGP, giving a P/E of 7.01. For Edita (EFID), consolidated net profit for 2024 was 1,606,727,698 EGP and for 2025 was 2,695,301,670 EGP, with earnings per share of 2.18 EGP and a price of 20.40 EGP, giving a P/E of 9.36. For Talaat Moustafa Group (TMGH), consolidated net profit for 2024 was 12,769,517,325 EGP and for 2025 was 18,201,981,482 EGP, with an earnings per share of 6.98 EGP and a price of 82.50 EGP, giving a P/E of 11.82. CIB (COMI) offers the most attractive valuation with the lowest P/E ratio of 7.01 alongside robust net profit growth. Therefore, we buy 312 shares of COMI at 128.00 EGP per share, totaling 39,936.00 EGP, which keeps the total holding value below half of the 80,000.00 EGP portfolio value to maintain diversification.
